svg.title: Where a routed token chunk goes
svg.desc: A two-node route through InfiniBand, a gateway and NVLink, linked to forward and backward timelines generated by TileFoundry.

g.text: Where a routed token chunk goes
B300 study · 32 nodes × 16 GPUs · 1,048,576 tokens/sequence · training batch open
fwd Weight and sum expert outputs
Keeps the original token / expert slots
Source and 15 other GPUs in this node
Gateway, expert owner and 14 other GPUs · selected route highlighted
The selected expert is on another GPU in the remote node. Same-node routes use the local NVLink fabric.
Tile = one chunk of routed token rows
One row = one routed token activation
Group routed rows into one unit of transfer and expert computation.
The same tile ID follows their activations, expert outputs and input-gradient contributions.
Example size: 128 BF16 rows = 1.75 MiB per activation hop.
Tile count sets the work shown along one route; sequence length and batch size are separate inputs.
